description: Export an owned enrichment sheet to deterministic UTF-8 CSV in its visible column order, one line per sheet row (a company's columns repeat on each of its people). perCompany: one line per company instead (the list of accounts), with how many of its people the sheet has and the first one. In the dashboard the returned CSV is downloaded automatically.

perCompany.description: One line per company (Pessoas na planilha, Primeiro decisor) instead of one per row.

name: export_sheet_csv
title: Exportar planilha em CSV
